analysis: The supplied PR change is documentation-only: CHANGELOG.md gains an 'Unreleased — coordinator schema migrations' entry (patch lines 1-10). It describes moving the coordinator Postgres schema to numbered goose migrations, with a 3s lock timeout, up to three attempts, an advisory lock for concurrent coordinators, startup failure without recording the baseline when a required statement fails, a checked-in schema.sql, and preserved later versions (consumer-settlement, legacy MDM cohort, small-model interest, Stripe refund index). No migration code, schema files, or tests were supplied, so the actual implementation is not reviewed. The next pass should examine the migration runner and the migration SQL for these security-relevant points. First, the legacy MDM cohort tables and indexes (TB-009 current_limitations, LegacyMDMCohortStore) must be created and frozen correctly, and a failed or partial migration must not let the cohort freeze with missing columns. Second, the consumer-settlement and ledger constraints (A-009, T-030), which duplicate-payout and duplicate-credit protections depend on. Third, App Attest and revocation tables (A-015, A-016, A-017, T-053, T-054). Fourth, the advisory lock and retry behavior, which affects startup availability, and fail-closed startup if a revocation or qualification table is absent. No concrete security regression is visible from the changelog text alone, so coverage is limited to the changelog text. Source-pass needs_deeper_review is set true because the migration implementation was not supplied.
